findings.issue: The source upgrade includes sc-command's RMCP dependency, but the release contract only identifies a new sc-runtime package. Have c-3 update sc-command's package version and all affected runtime/template requirements, and c-4 publish/verify the affected command package before the runtime. findings.issue: The promised selective-version release has no executable path through the existing pinned publishing kit. The configured publish plan contains all five crates; crates-publish derives one version from the release tag for every registry lookup, and release validation requires publishable crate versions to inherit the workspace version. That conflicts with bumping only affected packages while keeping unaffected crates on 0.1.1. Reusing the workflow would either reject literal mixed versions or attempt to republish unchanged packages under a mismatched tag assumption.
findings.required_correction: Assign c-1 an explicit compatible publication contract/probe for affected-only versions: determine and prove the pinned kit's supported publish=false/literal-base/selective publication behavior or qualify an upstream kit enhancement before promising release closure. Have c-4 change canonical consumer inputs/pin and regenerate installer outputs rather than hand editing vendored workflows; include all required generated output paths in ownership. Preserve the owner's no-unnecessary-version-bumps rule and stop on a demonstrated upstream capability gap. Record the dependency order, tag semantics, and per-package registry checks using existing release mechanisms.
